evidence: LaAlO3 thin films were deposited in a horizontal gas flow reactor at 300 o C with the precursors lanthanum tris( N,N’-diisopropylformamidinate), trimethylaluminum (TMA) and H 2O. The lanthanum precursor was heated to 120 o C in an oven, while TMA and H2O were kept at ambient temperature. A sub-cycle was the sequential dosing of the metal precursor and H2O with a nitrogen purge following each dose.
